analysis.summary_en: ThinkRail is an agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it.
highlights: Isolated workspaces. Open any git repo as a project and create git worktree workspaces from it, each with its own branch and working directory. Agents can then work in parallel without touc…
Find chats. ⌘K (or a double tap of Shift) opens a "Switch sessions" popup that lets you find chats across your workspaces and projects.
Skills. ThinkRail imports skills from pi, Claude, Codex, and other coding agents, as well as any already in your project.
